defects.source_says: Section 1-101 of the held text: '...shall be effective on July 1, 1978.' The order is dated June 30, 1978 and the claim's own judgment_reason and savings text give July 1, 1978. The end date predates the order and the 1978 Reorganization Plan it implements.

evidence_checked: jobs/selden-fr-citers/output/texts/fr-2022-24484.txt (87 FR 67875, Navy certificate of alternate compliance citing EO 11964)
reasoning: Spans and hash match; identity (January 19, 1977, 42 FR 4327, title) confirmed. Six clauses cover sections 1(a)-(c), 2, 3 and 4; inventory complete. The July 15, 1977 date defines the Convention's entry into force and the exemptible class of vessels, not an end. Cruden finds exactly the six files the claim lists; the 2022 Navy notice applies section 1; 33 CFR parts 81 and 82 cite the order as authority. No amendment or revocation held. Note: the rationale calls the CFR texts 'custody records without held bytes' while section 4's reason calls them 'held CFR texts'; they are held, and they are not cited as sources, so the inconsistency is immaterial.
